description: Public administration, government agencies, municipalities, associations, chambers, public institutions
typical_workflows: Application processing: Citizen applications, permits, decisions
Citizen services: Answering inquiries, providing information
Document management: Record keeping, archiving, follow-ups
Decision drafting: Formal documents with legal binding
Statistics/Reporting: Evaluations for reports and decisions
common_pain_points: High bureaucracy: Many forms, strict regulations
Staff shortage: Too few employees for rising inquiries
Outdated IT: Legacy systems, low digitalization
Long processing times: Citizens wait weeks/months
Standard inquiries: 80% of inquiries are routine
Compliance: Strict data protection and administrative regulations
ai_opportunities: Chatbot for citizen services: Hours, forms, status
Decision templates: Standardized decisions via AI template
Case file summaries: Quickly capture long cases
Translations: Administrative texts to plain language
FAQ automation: Frequent citizen inquiries automated
